title: Twin Rivers Tigoni for Team Building: What Each Activity Costs and How to Run the Day
meta_title: Twin Rivers Tigoni Team Building: Activities and Rates
meta_description: Twin Rivers Tigoni team building: activity rates, day pass, sample programmes and travel tips from Nairobi. Plan your company day out with us.
excerpt: Planning a company day at Twin Rivers Tigoni? Here are the resort's activity rates, the day pass, sample programmes and the practical details from Nairobi.
content:
Twin Rivers Tigoni is an outdoor adventure resort in the tea country near Limuru, about 28 km from Nairobi, and it works well for company team building because everything sits on one site: lawns for games, zip lines, high ropes, sky cycling, archery, target paintball, quad bikes and river trails, with most sky games at KES 600-800 per person.

The tricky part for whoever is organising is not choosing fun activities. It is working out what the day will really cost per head, which activities suit a mixed group, and how to stop the bus ride and lunch from eating half the programme. This guide sets out the resort's published activity rates, sample timetables and the practical details that decide whether the day runs smoothly.

Quick Facts

  • Location: Kentmere-Redhill Road, Tigoni, near Limuru in Kiambu County
  • Distance from Nairobi: about 28 km; allow 45-60 minutes, longer in rush hour
  • Opening hours: 9:00am to 5:00pm, every day of the week
  • Entry: KES 500 adults, KES 300 children (as published, November 2026; confirm before booking)
  • Sky games: KES 500-800 per person each, or any three for KES 2,000
  • Day pass: KES 5,000 Monday-Thursday, KES 6,000 Friday-Sunday per person
  • Best for: groups who want a full active day without a long drive

What Is Twin Rivers Tigoni Like for a Company Day Out?

Twin Rivers Tigoni is a green, hilly resort set among tea farms where two small rivers meet, with a waterfall and river area, open lawns and nature trails. For a company day out it feels like a proper escape from the office, yet it is close enough that nobody spends more time on the road than on the activities.

Twin Rivers Tigoni also has a restaurant and bar on site, which keeps lunch simple for a big group, and the cool highland air makes a change from a hotel conference room.

For background on why this belt of Kiambu is covered in tea, the Tea Board of Kenya's history of the industry is a good short read before you go. The farms frame the drive in and the nature trails at Twin Rivers Tigoni.

A Twin Rivers Tigoni day suits teams of almost any size, from a ten-person department to a full company outing. Large groups can be split into rotating squads, so one team is on the high ropes while another is shooting arrows and a third is out on the trails.

Which Activities Can Your Team Do at Twin Rivers?

At Twin Rivers Tigoni your team can choose from five sky games (ziplining, sky cycling, high ropes, the giant swing and wall climbing), ground games such as archery, target paintball, giant Jenga and lawn games, indoor games, quad biking and nature walks. Mix thrills with calmer options so nobody sits out.

Sky games: the confidence builders

The sky games are the headline at Twin Rivers Tigoni. Ziplining runs over the tea plantation, sky cycling puts riders on a bike along a suspended track, and the high ropes course and giant swing test nerve and trust. Adventure activities have age, height and safety requirements, and instructors provide helmets and gloves.

Ground and lawn games: the levellers

Archery, giant Jenga, ring toss, cornhole, Connect 4 and tic-tac-toe are the activities that bring everyone in, including colleagues who would rather not leave the ground. They are also cheap at Twin Rivers Tigoni, because most are priced per group for two hours rather than per person.

Quad biking and trails

Quad bike trails at Twin Rivers Tigoni run for roughly 5 to 10 km through the farmland, and the nature trails give a gentler walk along the river. Quad biking is included in the all-inclusive day pass; separate quad rates and full team-building packages were not on the price list we hold and are quoted on request.

How Much Does Twin Rivers Tigoni Team Building Cost?

Twin Rivers Tigoni activities cost from KES 200 for an indoor game to KES 1,500 for a weekend two-way sky cycle, plus the KES 500 entry fee, or KES 5,000-6,000 per person for the all-inclusive day pass. Transport, facilitation and lunch are extra.

Twin Rivers Tigoni combos, the Adrenaline Package and the day pass

At Twin Rivers Tigoni, pairs of sky games are sold as combos at KES 1,200 to 1,300 per person on weekdays and KES 1,500 at weekends. Ziplining with high ropes, ziplining with the giant swing, and the giant swing with high ropes are the cheaper pairs at KES 1,200; any pair that includes sky cycling is KES 1,300.

The Adrenaline Package lets each person pick any three sky games for KES 2,000. An All Inclusive Sky Package covers all five sky games, but its price was not on the list we hold, so ask us for it.

The all-inclusive day pass is KES 5,000 per person from Monday to Thursday and KES 6,000 from Friday to Sunday. It covers entrance, the sky games, a quad biking experience, indoor and outdoor games, 10 rounds of paintball and the nature trails, which makes it the simplest option for a team that wants to try everything.

A worked example for 30 people on a weekday

Say 30 colleagues visit Twin Rivers Tigoni on a Wednesday. Entry plus the Adrenaline Package comes to KES 2,500 each, or KES 75,000 for the group, and adding archery and two lawn games for the whole group adds only KES 1,000. The day pass route would be KES 150,000, but includes quad biking and paintball. Transport, lunch and facilitation come on top of either figure.

Our advice is to give everyone the cheaper base programme and let the keen ones upgrade, rather than buying day passes for people who will never get on a quad bike. A facilitator also stops the day from turning into a queue for the zip line.

Sample Programmes: Half Day, Full Day and Overnight

A half day at Twin Rivers Tigoni fits ice-breakers, two activities and lunch; a full day from 9am to about 5pm adds facilitated challenges, sky games, competitions and a closing debrief; and an overnight camp adds a bonfire evening and a slower second morning. Pick the length by what you want people to take back to the office.

Half day (about 9am to 2pm)

  • 7:30am: depart Nairobi by bus or minibus
  • 9:00am: arrival, safety briefing, ice-breakers on the lawn
  • 9:45am: rotating squads on archery and ziplining
  • 12:00pm: lawn games and a short team challenge
  • 1:00pm: lunch at the resort restaurant, then return to Nairobi

Full day (about 9am to 5pm)

  • 9:00am: arrival, briefing and facilitated warm-up games
  • 10:00am: the Adrenaline Package in rotating squads (three sky games each)
  • 12:30pm: lunch
  • 1:30pm: target paintball and archery competition, scored by team
  • 3:00pm: problem-solving challenge on the lawns, or quad bikes for day-pass holders
  • 4:15pm: debrief, prize-giving and photos, then depart

Overnight camp

Twin Rivers Tigoni lists camping grounds among its facilities, so a team can stay over, run an evening bonfire session and spend the next morning on the nature trails before heading home. For a fuller residential retreat with rooms and a conference hall, our guide to a Naivasha corporate retreat compares lakeside venues two hours from Nairobi, and the Chaka Ranch two-day team building package is another tried format.

How Do You Get to Tigoni From Nairobi?

You reach Tigoni from Nairobi along Limuru Road through Ruaka and Banana, then onto the Kentmere-Redhill Road. The resort is about 28 km away; the trip is roughly 40 to 45 minutes in light traffic, but weekday mornings can easily push it beyond an hour.

For groups, one hired bus or a couple of minibuses is far easier than a convoy of private cars. Everyone arrives together, nobody gets lost on the farm roads, and the driver waits while you play. Leave by 7:30am to make a 9am start, and plan the return before the evening rush builds.

What should people wear?

Tell your team to wear closed shoes with grip, trousers or leggings that allow movement, and layers. Twin Rivers Tigoni is cooler and often damper than central Nairobi, especially in the morning and during the rains, so a light waterproof is sensible. Leave jewellery and loose sunglasses on the bus before the sky games.

Is Twin Rivers Right for Your Team? Honest Trade-offs

Twin Rivers Tigoni is right for teams who want an active, outdoor day close to Nairobi with plenty of choice. It is less suited to groups who need a formal conference hall, team-versus-team paintball, or a venue that never depends on the weather. Knowing that before you book saves a lot of disappointment.

Where Twin Rivers shines

The mix of sky games and low-key lawn games means a 25-year-old graduate and a senior manager with a bad knee can both have a good day. Twin Rivers Tigoni prices are clear and modest by the activity, and the river and tea setting makes the photos look far better than a car park in town.

Where another venue may fit better

The paintball at Twin Rivers Tigoni is target shooting only, so teams who want battles should look elsewhere. Rain can cut sky games short, so build in indoor games or a flexible timetable. If your group is comparing venues, our guide to the best team building venues near Nairobi lines them up, and Burudani Adventure Park and Nkasiri Adventure Park are the closest alternatives in style.

For a ready-made programme at the neighbouring Limuru venue, see our full-day corporate team building at Burudani. Companies that want to reward staff with a longer trip can look at our corporate and incentive safaris.

Insider Tips

  • Book weekdays: sky games are KES 200 cheaper per person Monday to Thursday, which adds up fast for a big team
  • Split into squads: groups of 8-12 rotate between activities and avoid queues at the zip line
  • Mix the menu: pair one sky game with archery or lawn games so nobody feels left out
  • Plan for rain: keep indoor games and a debrief space in reserve, especially in April-May and November
  • Share the dress code: closed shoes, trousers and a warm layer; send it with the calendar invite
  • Fix the headcount early: confirm numbers and any medical or height concerns a week ahead

Frequently Asked Questions

How much is the entrance fee at Twin Rivers Tigoni?

The entrance fee at Twin Rivers Tigoni is KES 500 per adult and KES 300 per child (as published, November 2026; confirm before booking). Activities cost extra, unless your team buys the all-inclusive day pass, which covers entry, the sky games, quad biking, paintball and the trails.

Is Twin Rivers Tigoni good for team building?

Yes. Twin Rivers Tigoni suits team building because everything happens on one site: open lawns for facilitated games, a set of sky games for confidence challenges, archery and target paintball for friendly competition, and nature trails for a quieter break. It is also close enough to Nairobi that a full programme fits comfortably between 9am and 5pm.

How far is Twin Rivers from Nairobi?

Twin Rivers sits in Tigoni, near Limuru, roughly 28 km from central Nairobi by road. Without traffic the drive can take around 40 to 45 minutes, but on a weekday morning it is wiser to allow an hour or more. Most companies leave Nairobi by 7:30am to start activities at 9am.

Is the paintball at Twin Rivers team against team?

No. The paintball listed on the resort price list is target shooting, sold as 20 rounds per person, so nobody gets hit. That makes it a good option for mixed teams who want a scoring competition without bruises or stained clothes. If your group specifically wants team-versus-team battles, tell us early so we can suggest a venue that offers them.

Can we stay overnight at Twin Rivers for a team retreat?

Twin Rivers lists camping grounds among its facilities, so an overnight camp is possible for teams who want an evening bonfire and a second day of activities. Camping rates and tent hire were not on the price list we hold, so Divulge Adventures confirms them in your quote along with meals, transport and facilitation.

Final Thoughts

Twin Rivers Tigoni gives Nairobi teams a full outdoor day without a long drive: clear activity prices, a good spread of sky games and gentler options, and a setting among the tea farms that feels a world away from the office. Book a weekday, split into squads and mix the activities, and the day largely runs itself.
